rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a geometric angle and for a viewpoint or perspective.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gok3 dou6 hai6 gau2 sap6 dou6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for placing something at a slant.

example.english: Angle the book on the table.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 bun2 syu1 daa2 ce4 baai2 hai2 toi4 min6

rows.traditional: 用 A 角度去講 B
rows.jyutping: jung6 A gok3 dou6 heoi3 gong2 B
rows.note: Use this when presenting or arguing about B from viewpoint A.

example.english: We angle our discussion of this policy from an environmental perspective, so everyone will accept it more easily.
example.traditional: 我哋用環保角度去講呢個政策，大家會易啲接受。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 waan4 bou2 gok3 dou6 heoi3 gong2 ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 daai6 gaa1 wui5 ji6 di1 zip3 sau6

rows.note: Use this for a vehicle, object, or moving thing that suddenly veers into a sharp turn.

example.english: I have to angle the car into a sharp turn here.
example.traditional: 我行到呢個位要急轉彎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 dou3 ni1 go3 wai2 jiu3 gap1 zyun3 waan1

rows.note: Use this for the physical corner where two walls of a building meet, rather than for a mathematical angle.

example.english: The cat hid in the angle between the walls.
example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 nik1 hai2 coeng4 gok3

rows.note: Use this for a turn or bend in a route or movement that changes direction.

example.english: The turn ahead is at a very sharp angle, so drive slowly.
example.traditional: 前面個轉彎好急，揸慢啲。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 go3 zyun2 waan1 hou2 gap1 zaa1 maan6 di1

rows.note: Use this when viewpoint means someone's way of seeing or opinion, rather than a literal or geometric angle.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 tai2 faat3
